title: Control Reinforcement Learning: Interpretable Token-Level Steering of LLMs via Sparse Autoencoder Features

bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice question answering using the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) dataset, which assigns a binary reward (+1 for unbiased answers, 0 for biased answers) to evaluate the model's reliance on stereotypes in both ambiguous and disambiguated contexts.
